text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedure as indicated by P1 
 in the above title block depending on external/internal leakage.
This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (open / closed only 
 state).
Technical Specification:
Type of Valve | Eccentric disc 
 control valves
Size | 12"
Body material | Stainless steel
Medium | Water steam
Joint | Flanshed
Packing | Buna non-adjustable
Shaft | Cast steel 316 sst
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by 
 eng. Ali Abdel-Salam, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood general 
 director, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head sector of Talkha PS.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear safety 
 helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs .... etc
Isolate valve mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this valve.
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Spanner, 
 gasket, spacer ring.
Cleaning 
 liquid.
Blanco, anti 
 seize.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure the valve was out 
 of operation and the pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must 
 be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is 
 drained.
Clean from foreign 
 material.
Lap the disk wear or 
 cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it 
 is bad.
Make machining for stem 
 or replace the defect.
Replace the pen if it is 
 wear.
Retighten the gland if it 
 is leakage or replace it.
